title: derepdx: diagnostics for SNP-distance dereplication blind to structural variation
description:
derepdx implements the nine runnable diagnostics of Table 3 of the companion manuscript as a command-line tool. Dereplication by SNP distance assumes that close in SNPs means the same organism; that assumption fails silently when a large deletion (which contributes exactly zero to a jointly-called-site distance), a reference-based quality metric used as a filter, or a reference-relative absence of unknown polarity changes the composition of a dereplicated set.

Every command takes tables in and returns a verdict out; the tool never reads BAM/VCF/FASTA, so it installs with pip and runs on a laptop. It ships its own small test fixtures and a derepdx demo that reproduces the full positive/negative matrix in one run.

The tools report; the human decides. Two diagnostics (polarity and check-qc-covariate) end in a judgement call.
